description: This file defines a configuration class for handling Azure OpenAI models, specifically o1 and o3 model families, including parameter support, streaming behavior, and request transformation.

classes.name: AzureOpenAIO1Config
classes.description: Configuration class for Azure o1 and o3 models, extending OpenAIOSeriesConfig with methods for supported parameters, streaming, and request transformation.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters for a given model, excluding unsupported ones.

methods.name: _get_o_series_only_params
methods.description: Helper method to determine o-series specific parameters, such as reasoning_effort, based on model recognition and reasoning support.

methods.name: should_fake_stream
methods.description: Determines whether to fake streaming for a given model based on its support for native streaming and other conditions.

methods.name: is_o_series_model
methods.description: Checks if a model belongs to the o1, o3, o4, or o_series family.

methods.name: transform_request
methods.description: Transforms the request parameters, notably removing 'o_series/' from the model name before calling the superclass method.
